scientific_integrity: Exact finite formulas are proved by a walk bijection and determinant identity; asymptotic assertions by Perron spectral estimates and a saddle-point bound. Exhaustive finite tests only corroborate the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Claims concern idempotents of weak graph endomorphism monoids of labeled simple undirected cycles. Strict/ordinary endomorphism enumeration and rushed Dyck path results are established prior work and expressly excluded from novelty. Possible equivalent weak Motzkin result in uninspected literature remains a priority risk. Independent validation is not claimed.
title: Rushed Motzkin retractions: exact rank census and stretched-exponential rarity for weak cycle endomorphisms
